ONNX Runtime Web (onnxruntime-web) — License
=============================================

Package installed:    onnxruntime-web@1.21.0
NPM:                  https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web
Upstream project:     https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
Package.json license: "MIT"

Note: the onnxruntime-web npm package as published does not include a
LICENSE file of its own. Its README (node_modules/onnxruntime-web/README.md)
points to the parent monorepo license:
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/main/README.md#license
-> https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/main/LICENSE

The text below was fetched directly from the upstream repository's LICENSE
file pinned at the git tag matching the installed version, v1.21.0:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/v1.21.0/LICENSE
(fetched and verified in this session; not reconstructed from memory).

Also confirmed in-repo: the WASM/JS runtime bundled inside
vendor/cutout/worker.mjs (via @imgly/background-removal, which vendors
onnxruntime-web) carries this header in
vendor/cutout/worker.mjs.LEGAL.txt:

  ONNX Runtime Web v1.21.0
  Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.
  Licensed under the MIT License.

That same bundle also contains third-party WebGL/WebGPU backend code
copyright 2019-2021 Google LLC, licensed Apache License 2.0 (TensorFlow.js
derived code). See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt for the Apache-2.0 text and full
attribution — that code did not need to be independently re-verified here
since its exact header text is already embedded verbatim in
worker.mjs.LEGAL.txt.

Unresolved: onnxruntime-web's own transitive dependencies (flatbuffers,
long, onnxruntime-common, platform, protobufjs, guid-typescript) are listed
in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt with license type and copyright as found in each
installed package, but were not cross-checked against upstream tagged
releases the way this MIT text was — only the top-level onnxruntime-web
license was pinned to an official tag per the task's explicit ask.
